title: chat-client: settle post-ops7.20 pub surface for 0.4
description: Freeze blocker from the third 2026-10-20 freeze review. Two open chat-client API-shape decisions are not linked to JMAP-lrgt and have no 'bd:' commit; deciding either after 0.4 would break semver. (1) JMAP-y7iy: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/types.rs:23 pub enum ContactPresenceFilter (+ TryFrom at L36) is still exported, but JMAP-ops7.20 (14c2765c) removed its only consumer, so it is dead public API. (2) JMAP-ops7.22: grep -c 'pub fn new' crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/*.rs finds 16 constructors on *Input/*Patch types, where sibling clients use Default + struct literals. The ops7.20 comment said to decide ops7.7, ops7.20 and ops7.22 together; only ops7.20 was decided (positional). Decide on both (remove or keep, Default vs new) before 0.4 and close y7iy and ops7.22 to match.
